conventions.features: kit parts and the antenna mount: chains of coaxial concave cylindrical and conical faces of radius <= 12 mm; a scored hole is one cylindrical step whose wall covers at least 300 deg about its axis: a chain whose cylindrical steps all reach 300 deg is one hole with all its steps, and inside a chain that does not, each cylindrical step of at least 300 deg is one hole of that step alone (the chain's axis, the step's radius); point_mm = axis point at the chain's opening, dir = axis into the material; the deck: one feature per concave face the grader's concave_axial_faces reads at features.fitted_tol_rel / fitted_tol_abs (point_mm = the axis at the top opening plane, ellipse [a, b] information only); slots, cut-outs and arcs under 300 deg are not features
conventions.frames: BASE: the car frame. Other types: principal axes of the anchor constituent (axis_only types: z = its axis of rotation), each within 1 deg of a car axis replaced by it, origin at the centre of the lower face of the first instance's exact bounding box in those axes
conventions.symmetry: rotations about the type's local +z axis through the local origin that map every constituent onto a constituent of equal volume within 0.05 mm; order = largest n of 2..12 with all multiples, 'continuous' when generic angles also map; flip_symmetric = a half turn about a local transverse axis through the middle of the local z extent also maps; axis_only = the spin about local z is not graded (set per type: DIFF, DRIVESHAFT, WHEELSET)
conventions.contact: exact B-rep distance between solids of two owners <= 0.05 mm (overlap counts as contact)
conventions.interference: common volume > 0.01 mm^3 from exact booleans with a closed volume balance (else the grader tessellation's manifold common volume, named per pair)
conventions.light: constituent volume < recognition.light_volume_mm3 of grader_config.json and not the anchor
conventions.second_instances: WHEELSET-2 and DRIVESHAFT-2: one STEP per type holds the first instance's geometry; the second instance is that geometry at the best rigid fit to the model's own solids of that instance (the model's two sets are not exact rigid copies of each other); registration_max_err_mm is that fit's residual
